references.text: The census of the sons of Issachar and their clans, which forms the basis for the tribal allocation in Joshua's time.
Issachar's birth as a son of Jacob and Leah, the origin of the tribe of Issachar which here receives its inheritance.
Jacob's blessing over Issachar, which prophesied about the tribe's future settlement and character.
Moses' blessing over Issachar, which also mentions the tribe's share in the promised land.
The description of the casting of lots process used to distribute the land among the tribes, the same method used here for Issachar.
The first census of Issachar's descendants in the wilderness, which later determined their inheritance portion.
